name: Landing page renders and switches between Studio and Template studio
description: The landing page loads with hero, navigation sections and footer, and the mode switch tabs change the visible workbench between the structured Studio and the HTML Template studio.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and wait for the page to fully load.
Verify the DeckForge hero is visible with the app branding 'DeckForge AI' and a primary call-to-action to create a presentation.
Verify the landing page contains the sections 'Systems', 'Method', 'Workbench' and 'Decks', and a footer.
Find the mode switch near the top with two tabs: 'Studio — structured' and 'Template studio — HTML decks'. Confirm 'Studio — structured' is the default active tab.
Click the 'Template studio — HTML decks' tab.
Verify the Template studio view appears, including a 'Pick a template' section and a Brief input area.
Click back to the 'Studio — structured' tab.
Verify the Studio create workbench is visible again, including the 'A · Brief' label area and the 'Forge the outline' button.
